title: Weather
summary: The weather of the day for each of the four seasons, with a temperature that rolls itself. Some rows only fit the day or the night.

tables.name: Weather: spring
rows: Mild and bright, around [[1d6+10]] degrees, with a light breeze that smells of wet earth.
Gentle rain all day, around [[1d4+7]] degrees. The roads turn to mud.
Cool and cloudy, around [[1d6+5]] degrees, and the clouds keep promising rain they do not deliver.
A sudden hailstorm for a quarter of an hour, then a clear sky. Around [[1d6+6]] degrees.
Fog over the fields until midmorning, then warm sun. Around [[1d6+8]] degrees.
Strong winds from the west, around [[1d6+8]] degrees. Everything not tied down is on the move.
A warm, windless day, around [[1d6+12]] degrees. Bees everywhere.
Showers on and off, with a rainbow every hour or so. Around [[1d6+8]] degrees.
Cold morning frost that melts by noon. Around [[1d4+3]] degrees at dawn, [[1d6+10]] at midday.
Thunder rolls in from the hills in the afternoon. Around [[1d6+9]] degrees, and then a heavy downpour.

rows.text: A clear night with a thin moon and a sky full of stars. Around [[1d4+2]] degrees.
Bright sun and a deep blue sky. Around [[1d6+13]] degrees at midday.

tables.name: Weather: summer
rows: Hot and dry, around [[1d6+25]] degrees. Shade is worth gold.
Warm and bright, around [[1d6+20]] degrees, with a soft breeze that only comes in the evening.
Heavy and humid, around [[1d6+23]] degrees. Everyone is sticky and short tempered.
A storm in the afternoon with thunder you can feel in your chest. Around [[1d6+18]] degrees before, [[1d6+12]] after.
A dust haze hangs over the roads, around [[1d6+24]] degrees. The sun is a red disc.
A light, refreshing rain at dawn, then a warm clear day. Around [[1d6+19]] degrees.
Mild and pleasant, around [[1d6+17]] degrees. Perfect weather for a long walk.
Smoke on the horizon from a distant fire, around [[1d6+22]] degrees. The light turns amber.
Thick fog in the valleys until noon, clear and warm above. Around [[1d6+18]] degrees.
Wind from the coast brings relief and the smell of salt. Around [[1d6+19]] degrees.

rows.text: A warm night with fireflies in the long grass. Around [[1d6+14]] degrees.
The sun stands high and the shadows are short, around [[1d6+26]] degrees. Nobody wants to move before the evening.

tables.name: Weather: autumn
rows: Crisp and clear, around [[1d6+8]] degrees. The leaves are red and gold and the light is soft.
Steady drizzle all day, around [[1d4+6]] degrees. Everything smells of wet wood.
Strong wind with gusts that tear leaves from the trees, around [[1d6+6]] degrees.
Cold and gray, around [[1d4+4]] degrees, with low clouds that never quite rain.
Heavy fog until noon, around [[1d4+5]] degrees. Sounds carry strangely.
A warm day out of season, around [[1d6+14]] degrees. People forget the cold is coming.
A cold rain with sleet at the end of the day. Around [[1d4+2]] degrees.
A clear, still day with a sharp chill in the shadows. Around [[1d6+7]] degrees.
Flocks of birds fly south in long lines, around [[1d6+8]] degrees. The sky is full of them.
A storm rolls in from the sea with rain that falls sideways. Around [[1d6+7]] degrees.

rows.text: A moonlit night with a cold edge and a ring around the moon. Around [[1d4+1]] degrees.
A bright, golden afternoon that makes everyone stop and look. Around [[1d6+10]] degrees.

tables.name: Weather: winter
rows: Bitterly cold and clear, around minus [[1d6+3]] degrees. Breath hangs in the air.
Heavy snowfall all day, around minus [[1d4]] degrees. The world goes quiet and white.
A thin freezing rain, around [[1d3-1]] degrees. Every step is a risk.
A blizzard with wind that cuts through cloaks, around minus [[1d6+5]] degrees. Travel is nearly impossible.
Gray and raw, around [[1d4]] degrees, with a fine drizzle that soaks into everything.
A pale sun on a crust of snow, around minus [[1d4]] degrees. Glare hurts the eyes.
A hard frost after a clear night, around minus [[1d6+2]] degrees. Ponds are covered with ice.
Light flurries that never settle, around [[1d3]] degrees. The sky is the color of pewter.
A thaw, around [[1d4+2]] degrees. The snow turns to slush and the roads to soup.
Cold fog that freezes onto every twig and makes the whole forest sparkle. Around minus [[1d4]] degrees.

rows.text: A clear, bitter night full of stars, around minus [[1d6+6]] degrees. Somewhere far off a wolf howls.
A short bright day with sunlight on the snow, around minus [[1d3]] degrees. The sun is gone by the afternoon.
